name: Jalna
registryAssessment: Official Maharashtra land-record pages identify the Jalna District Superintendent of Land Records and Deputy Superintendent offices, and the official state service portal identifies Mahabhunakasha/Bhu-Naksha as the map service. No bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified, so local registry presence is not converted into runtime source admission.
